title: 茶
text: 茶是以茶樹的嫩葉及芽經不同加工工序製成的茶葉，並以熱水沖泡而成的飲料。茶樹屬山茶科山茶屬常綠喬木或小喬木，其自然分布一般認為位於中國西南部、印度東北部及緬甸北部交界地區，其中中國雲南被視為茶樹的重要原生分布區之一。現代商業茶葉幾乎全部由茶樹及其主要變種，或其近緣種如大理茶、台灣山茶等製成，而以其他植物沖泡而成的飲品，如洋甘菊茶、博士茶或洛神花茶等，雖慣稱為「花茶」或「草本茶」，但植物學及食品科學上並不屬於真正的茶。 茶是世界上最廣泛飲用的飲品之一，普遍被認為僅次於水，也是是全球三大無酒精飲料之一。由於茶葉所含的咖啡因、茶氨酸、茶多酚及多種揮發性芳香化合物，茶具有獨特的香氣、滋味及提神作用。不同的製作工藝會影響茶葉內部的酵素反應及氧化程度，形成色澤、香氣和滋味各異的產品。現代茶學一般按照加工工序及品質特徵，將茶分為綠茶、白茶、黃茶、青茶（烏龍茶）、紅茶及黑茶六大基本類別，各類茶之下再衍生出眾多地方品種及特色名茶。
changes: 節錄導言前兩段，移除註腳與換行、合併空白；中文採臺灣繁體轉換。

title: 自行車
text: 自行車是種以人力踩推腳踏板驅動的小型非機動車。漢語中的「自行車」通常是指兩輪前後縱列的雙輪車（bicycle），但也有三輪或單輪的。一般人日常騎車時速約為15—25公里（9.3—15.5英里），經過訓練的運動員騎行專用車，並通過伏低上身姿態利用空氣流線型，可達到時速45公里（28英里）。此外，自行車也曾被作為戰爭之用。

title: 图书馆
text: 圖書館是收集、整理、儲存文獻資訊並提供利用的機構。其館藏傳統上以書籍為主，今日則兼及報刊、音像製品、縮微製品與數位資源；服務對象可以是社會公眾，也可以是特定機構或人群。圖書館由公共財政、教育機構、企業、宗教團體或私人舉辦，在文獻儲存與知識傳播中長期居於樞紐地位。 「圖書館」一詞之源流，學界議論紛紜，或謂中文古已有之，或謂日人譯西書而定，或謂傳教士首譯。考諸文獻，此三字確於北宋黃庭堅、清人黎簡之詩中出現，惟其意涵與今之「library」有別。作為現代公共圖書館之對應名稱，則經歷日本明治時期之更迭，自「書樓」、「書籍館」等稱，終定為「圖書館」，首見於1877年東京大學法理文學部圖書館。其後，此詞回流中國，漸取代「藏書樓」等傳統用語。至若傳教士之翻譯，則多作「書房」、「書館」等，未見「圖書館」之固定用法。
changes: 節錄導言前兩段，移除註腳與換行、合併空白；中文採臺灣繁體轉換。

title: Coffee
text: Coffee is a beverage brewed from roasted, ground coffee beans. Dark-colored and bitter, coffee has a stimulating effect on humans due to its caffeine content; however decaffeinated coffee is also commercially available. There are also various coffee substitutes. Coffee production begins when the seeds from coffee cherries, the Coffea plant's fruits, are separated to produce unroasted green coffee beans. The "beans" are roasted and then ground into fine particles. Coffee is brewed from the ground roasted beans, which are typically steeped in hot water before being filtered out. It is usually served hot, although chilled or iced coffee is common. Coffee can be prepared and presented in a variety of ways, e.g., espresso, French press, caffè latte, or already-brewed canned coffee. Sugar, sugar substitutes, milk, and cream are often added and change the flavor.

title: Bicycle
text: A bicycle, also called a pedal cycle, bike, push-bike or cycle, is a human-powered or motor-assisted, pedal-driven, single-track vehicle, with two wheels attached to a frame, one behind the other. A bicycle rider is called a cyclist or bicyclist. The bicycle was invented in Europe in the 19th century. By the early 21st century, there were more than 1 billion bicycles. Bicycles are the principal means of transport in many regions. They are also popular for recreation, and have been adapted for use as children's toys. Bicycles are used for commuting, shopping, fitness, military and police applications, courier services, bicycle racing, and artistic cycling.

title: Library
text: A library is a collection of books, and possibly other materials and media, that is accessible for use by its members and members of allied institutions. Libraries provide physical (hard copies) or digital (soft copies) materials, and may be a physical location, a virtual space, or both. A library's collection normally includes printed materials which can be borrowed, and usually also includes a reference section of publications which may only be utilized inside the premises. Resources such as commercial releases of films, television programmes, other video recordings, radio, music and audio recordings may be available in many formats. These include DVDs, Blu-rays, CDs, cassettes, or other applicable formats such as microform. They may also provide access to information, music or other content held on bibliographic databases. In addition, some libraries offer creation stations for makers which offer access to a 3D printing station with a 3D scanner. Libraries can vary widely in size and may be organised and maintained by a public body such as a government, an institution (such as a school or museum), a corporation, or a private individual. In addition to providing materials, libraries also provide the services of librarians who are trained experts in finding, selecting, circulating and organising information while interpreting information needs and navigating and analysing large amounts of information with a variety of resources. The area of study is known as library and information science or studies.
